lines.text: A man in the crowd asks Jesus to tell his brother to divide the inheritance, but Jesus declines to judge.
Jesus warns the crowd to guard against every form of pride, because life is not about possessions.
A rich man's ground produces an abundance, so he plans to tear down his barns and build bigger ones.
The rich man plans to tell himself to take it easy, since he has plenty laid up for many years.
God tells the rich man that his barns will be burned with fire that very night.

wrong_details.wrong: His barns will be burned with fire
wrong_details.true: His life will be required of him
